definitions.explanation: the act of delaying or pushing back a decision, action, or matter to a later time

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先送|さきおく}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Putting off problems is not good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{先送|さきおく}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増税|ぞうぜい}→増税：12091_zouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先送|さきおく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced a postponement of the tax increase.

notes:
USAGE:
- {先送|さきおく}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to postpone, to put off)
- {先送|さきおく}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be postponed)
- {先送|さきおく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (to keep postponing)
Often used in business and political contexts when decisions or difficult issues are delayed. Frequently carries a negative nuance, implying avoidance of responsibility.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先送|さきおく}り (putting off problems)
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先送|さきおく}り (deferring a decision)
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先送|さきおく}り (postponing issues)
